tasks.title: Define ExecutorProtocol with typing.Protocol
tasks.description: Refactor backend/src/core/executor/base.py: Replace BaseExecutor ABC with ExecutorProtocol using typing.Protocol. Keep ExecutionResult and ReviewResult dataclasses. Add supported_task_types() -> list[str] method to the protocol. Write tests first (TDD).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: ExecutorProtocol is a typing.Protocol class with execute(), review(), and supported_task_types() methods. Old BaseExecutor is removed. Tests in backend/tests/core/executor/ verify the protocol contract.

tasks.title: Create ExecutorRegistry
tasks.description: Create backend/src/core/executor/registry.py with an ExecutorRegistry class. Methods: register(name: str, executor_factory: Callable) -> None, get(name: str) -> ExecutorProtocol, list_available() -> list[str]. Thread-safe singleton pattern. Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: ExecutorRegistry can register and retrieve executors by name. Raises KeyError for unknown executors. Tests cover register, get, list_available, and duplicate registration.

tasks.title: Refactor ClaudeCodeExecutor to implement ExecutorProtocol
tasks.description: Update backend/src/core/executor/claude_code.py to implement ExecutorProtocol (structural subtyping, no inheritance needed). Add supported_task_types() returning ['coding', 'refactor', 'bugfix', 'test']. Register it in the ExecutorRegistry. Update imports throughout the codebase. Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: ClaudeCodeExecutor satisfies ExecutorProtocol. It's registered in the registry. All existing tests still pass. New tests verify protocol compliance.

tasks.title: Add task_type and metadata fields to Task model
tasks.description: Add task_type: str (default='coding') and metadata: JSON (default={}) columns to the Task SQLAlchemy model in backend/src/models.py. Create an Alembic migration. Update Pydantic schemas in backend/src/schemas.py. Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Task model has task_type and metadata columns. Alembic migration exists and is valid. Schemas accept task_type and metadata. Existing tasks default to task_type='coding'. Tests verify defaults and serialization.

tasks.title: Update TaskRunner to use ExecutorRegistry
tasks.description: Modify backend/src/core/task_runner.py: LocalTaskRunner should accept executor_name (optional, default='claude_code') and resolve via ExecutorRegistry instead of taking a BaseExecutor directly. Update all callers (orchestrator, worker). Write tests first.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: LocalTaskRunner resolves executor from registry by task.task_type or explicit name. All existing tests pass. New tests verify registry-based resolution and fallback to default.

tasks.title: Code review — fix all issues including minor ones
tasks.description: Review all changes in this branch. Check: protocol compliance, test coverage >= 80%, no broken imports, backward compatibility (existing tasks still work), ruff check passes, no security issues. Fix any issues found.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: ruff check backend/src/ passes. pytest backend/tests/ --cov=backend/src --cov-fail-under=80 passes. No lint warnings. All imports are clean.
